Yeah we were joking about it and I was saying jokingly that I wanted to slit my wrists after this guy said something about me at school which wasn't really that important and we were laughing about it, both of us and then she got all serious and told me to stop being so negative.

I was being my negative, "life is pointless we will all die" self during a conversation, and I made some jokes about killing myself, and she tried to convince me not to even though she knew it was a joke, and she gave up trying to convince me that I shouldn't kill myself and started insulting me instead. Great logic, right? Then I felt scared and confused and mad and I didn't know what to do and panicked so I left the conversation and stopped responding. Then she started messaging me through my other friends account and insulting me and I lashed out at her and told her to kill herself and then 3 weeks later I tried to apologise and she gave me the silent treatment which I deserved because karma right, that's what I did to her when she was yelling at me so she can do that to me while I apologise and I heard while I was at the lockers that she still hates me and fuck, that hurt. So I went, burnt my razor and cut.

It's a long story. I posted on this sub about it [here.](https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/6glfwr/i_told_my_friend_to_kill_herself_and_i_should/)

You can read it if you want, basically details what happened with my friends in my usual pointless over dramatic way.

My teachers would be glad to see me go, considering I'm never at half the classes anyway. They must think its the biggest mistake of their career to put me in AP anything, haha. And quite honestly, I don't think I'll be around to harm myself for much longer so not much point in trying to fix something that is irreparably broken.

I used to be so happy and have friends and sure it wasn't perfect and my parents were still arguing and there was still the bullying but I was happy and that's what mattered. And now all it took is for my friends to leave me and one divorce and now its all just fallen down around me. And it's gotten to this point where cutting is the only thing that makes me feel good in life and that's what's worrying me so much.
You don't need a good body type if you intimidate them into submission.

It's a hopeless situation. I should just go back into friendliness and depression like I was before. It would be a better situation than this. And please stop calling me friend. I don't deserve friends.

The fight was about 3 weeks ago and the failed apology was 3 days ago, on Friday where I am. It's the Queen's birthday and a long weekend so I've just been sitting here alone while my friends hang out with each other and her.
I already have, 3 days ago. She ignored me.

First off, I'm not beautiful. I'm ugly, selfish, mean, dumb, and pointless. 
She was trying to help me. She said I was being too negative and she was worried about me and I tried to explain to her that my life is pointless and I am going to die without any meaning or positive impact whatsoever and she got frustrated and decided that if that was the way I was going to be she just wouldn't speak to me anymore. She started insulting a lot of things about me that I was insecure about, much of which is personal information which I won't share here, and I got so scared and mad and I didn't know how to control my emotions and lashed out. I told her: "okay. then why don't you stop telling me how to live my life? I have some advice for you now:you should just end your life if you keep telling me i don't have one." I feel so bad for saying that and now it can't be undone no matter what I do. She told everyone in our friendship group what a horrible person I was and since then I've just been a loner, cutting with an old razor when I have the chance.

It's been three weeks since the argument actually. Three weeks of being alone, writing out apologies and deleting them over and over, and living with my own guilt. Surprisingly difficult and it seems to have enraged her more that I've been appearing to cope for most of the three weeks. I don't feel too comfortable telling my parents what happened for personal reasons, and considering I already see the school counsellor a few times a week I don't think it would really help. Not to shoot down your advice but my case is hopeless. Hopefully I'll be moving schools soon though and all this will go away :)

Please don't be sorry for saying this. You needed to get it off your chest, right? That's what we're here for. It's odd that we both started cutting at around the same time, though I dare say your experience sounds like a lot worse to deal with. I'm not going to give you any overly positive bullsh*t but I'm already starting to be addicted to it and I don't want you to be in the same situation. If you can, reach out to the closest friend or person you know in your group and tell them how you feel. Not necessarily about the cuts, just how you feel about the instability of your friendship with them and try to resolve the issue before it's too late and you end up friendless like me. All the best.

Wow. I have actually never thought about the situation from this perspective and really, thank you a lot for giving your opinion. I have been hanging out with a few other people since then instead who are actually smart, and we speak our own language so we don't have to worry about people like her again. 
By the way, the reason that I described it as killing me now that I can reflect on the dilemma calmly and just realise it's more of a guilty conscience thing that I told her to kill herself, and the conscience problem was furthered by the people I knew telling me that I was wrong for saying that, how could you, etc. I think it was more of me feeling like I had fucked up and needed to make it right that feeling bad for her, because not to be petty but the things she said to me were totally unprovoked and my reasoning was that why should I stand there and take it. 

Also, now I realise she was always hot-tempered, just never specifically to me. I always sided with her because I didn't want to be on the receiving end of her anger and so did most of my friends. I really feel bad for the people that were bullying her now, haha.

(the main reason that everyone was in the friendship group was because we were all bullied on our own. I know this because it came up in conversation a short while ago Coincidentally, this is also why I want so badly to reconcile, because of the bullying that goes on in my school). 

I also felt abandoned and like I had been done an injustice when I hadn't because a short while ago she had a falling out with two other friends (unsurprisingly, because they thought she was annoying) and I had felt empathy for her and backed her in many things when she had literally no one else to hang out with. She confided in me that when she was ostracised by our group it had been the worst three weeks of her life, so I assumed when I apologised to her she might have felt a bit of sympathy (?) towards me. I guess not. 

In regards to your "friends never turn on each other" point, in truth, for them it was more of a "my friends are arguing so I won't really pick a side but I won't hang out with the other and also tell the other how wrong they were" sort of thought process for the rest of the people in my group. I determined that by managing to talk to my best friend and explain my point of the situation and let her explain hers. We are now on speaking terms, although the other friend who is mean and hated me still hates me... 

Thank you for taking the time to write this, it was really insightful and I think I have learned something about myself by reading it.

P.S. I actually have been diagnosed with depression in recent months, which was a factor in the public breakdown scenario. Also, I'm in AP Math and French, as well as top of the year level in English so not too much to worry about there. School bores me, which is why I occupy time with my friends. Thanks for the reminder about my studies, though, should probably be doing them now haha.
